overview: MetaZoo's first venture into NFTs, marketed at the time as **Genesis 2021**, sold through the Mintable storefront.
The sale opened on March 7th, 2021 with ten Mothman Contracts. Supply ran from 10 of the scarcest up to 100 of the most common, and the format varied:
- **Seven-day auctions** opening at $0.99, for tokens such as Squonk Baby and the NYC Sewer Alligator
- **Flat price** listed at $4.99, for tokens such as River Dino
MetaZoo deployed the contract from its own wallet on March 13th, 2021 and minted the tokens itself, in nine batches through that November. Purchases were made off-chain via the Mintable storefront.

947 Genesis tokens were minted on-chain (595 on the dedicated contract, 352 more inside the shared Mintable store), but **116 of them never left MetaZoo's own deployer wallet**, so ~831 reached collectors.
Almost all remaining unsold is a single block of 110 Piasa Birds, still sitting in the deployer wallet. Every other cryptid sold through at ~97%.
